answer: Identity is issued only after a 15-minute live notary session booked on a public calendar that opens 120 slots worldwide each day, plus a 2,600-unit bond locked for 28 days. The notary stores a liveness hash; a reused face, device, or funding trail voids the slot and burns the bond. An honest worker attends once and locks 2,600 units. Fielding 200 aliases needs 200 distinct appointments, nearly two days of global capacity, and 520,000 units left idle. Runners may wander from studio to studio, yet a repeated face is rejected, so cheap nectar from mass signups cannot ripen into a voting grove.
